<!--
The title is the commit subject: `<scope>: <imperative summary>`,
lowercase, no period, at most 72 characters, as `naming: keep a
trailing dot out of a folder name`.

A squash merge writes the title and this description to main as they
are, comments included, so replace these comments with the body:

Why the change: what was wrong or missing, and why this fixes it,
wrapped at 72 characters.

Then a `-` bullet for each file or area changed:

- naming.rs: what changed there

Tests and examples use invented names only, never a real artist,
title or video ID. `AGENTS.md` has the rules; CI checks the title and
description and warns about what it would change.
-->
